title: LIAR GAME
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Naive, scrupulously honest college student Nao Kanzaki is drawn into the Liar Game Tournament, where players are urged to lie and cheat to take each other's money and losers carry huge debts. She enlists con man Shinichi Akiyama, whose mother was driven to suicide by a pyramid scheme, and together they try to free other players from debt and bring down the organization behind the game.
life_message: It holds up that honesty and trust in others can outlast clever deceit, and that every person has value.

content.note: Psychological games rather than physical harm; one player is a black-belt fighter (Wikipedia; 'Death Game' signal; to verify).
Ruinous debts and mind games; menace from the organizers (Wikipedia).

Akiyama's mother died by suicide after a multi-level marketing scheme ruined her (Wikipedia); detail capped (to verify).

Pyramid schemes and money games exposed as predatory (Wikipedia).
